policy.spokenUnit: One Triplet = one short sentence for NPC voice at this presentation scale
policy.semanticStructure: Subject/Connector/Reframe are inner sentence roles, not three stand-alone utterances
policy.otherScales: King Kayfabian 3 Scene Cards can produce three short sentences plus player Closure at Quest scale; do not confuse A/B/C card stages with one Triplet
policy.sourcePriority: Card deck / cardName-power-lore / witnessed world fact / NPC knowledge
policy.visualRail: artworkPrompt distinct; don't claim the printed artwork was seen
policy.previous20Cutups: FORMAL_FAIL_AS_TRIPLET_3_FRAGMENTS; preserve raw source snippets as negative examples only
policy.wordBudget: prefer 5-9, normal up to approximately 15; no arbitrary three-line scripts
